LanguageData.VRE_AnimaAffinity.description: Carriers of this gene have a special connection to the anima tree, allowing them to act as an amplifier to the special properties of the tree. They can encourage anima trees to sing, giving everyone in large radius a psychic soothe, as well as help with connection and meditation to it.
LanguageData.VRE_AnimaAffinity.label: anima affinity
